adaptation.timing: 12 FPS and release/contact markers are authored adaptations, not vendor metadata.
adaptation.scale: 1.00; complete original 128px cells, source body and shadow remain byte-for-byte.
adaptation.ground: Body support is (64,87), or (64,69) for single-combatant riders. Prone/death depth uses measured original shadow centroids.
adaptation.effects: Only nonempty caster accents and Goblin17 muzzle flash are clip-owned original layers. They cause no gameplay effects.
adaptation.neutral_actions: Shared body contexts retain Idle for interactions without source gestures. Non-winged Fly holds Idle with shared magical lift.

ranged.coordinate_space: full 128x128 source cell; x right, y down; zero-based frame/row
ranged.source_member: 2D Orcs and Goblins - TopDown - V1.0/Seperate shadows and effects/Goblin 17/Attack 5.png
ranged.method: Measured final visible brown barrel tip; S is foreshortened and partly coincides with leg pixels. Original local flash is not guaranteed centred exactly on this tip.

terminal_death_review.selection: Separate terminal Death only. Existing Die, Prone, DYING/STABLE and reverse recovery remain unchanged.
terminal_death_review.timing: 15 original frames at existing explicit project adaptation 12 FPS; source PNGs declare no FPS.
terminal_death_review.registration: Ground depth uses original separate shadow alpha-weighted centroids with measured Idle reference. Body/source pixels and native contact are unchanged.
terminal_death_review.rest_attachment: Original shadow alpha centroid, preserving the Goblin attachment convention.
terminal_death_review.effects: Original Die2 body/shadow only; no separate effect exists.
